text:
Sam W: hey all — working on my first week patch, small change to the inference runtime config in pkg/serve. My PR passes unit tests locally but CI lints fail with `eslint --ext .ts,.tsx`. quick q: are we supposed to fix all lint errors in feature PRs or use `// eslint-disable` for minor stuff?

Tina L: welcome! generally we prefer fixing the lint unless it's a noisy autofix we can't do in one go. if it's a stylistic disagreement, open a quick issue and leave a comment in the PR. :+1:

Corey D: also run `pnpm -w eslint --fix` in the repo root — that fixes most formatting and simple rule issues. if the CI error is about types, that's different.

Sam W: thanks — CI shows this rule: "no-explicit-any" in src/runtime/kv.ts. it's a helper function that wraps external lib types. is it ok to add a narrow `any` with a TODO?

Marta R: prefer adding a tiny wrapper type instead of any. e.g.,
```
type RawKV = Record<string, unknown>;
function wrap(raw: RawKV) { /* ... */ }
```
If you need to, add `// TODO: refine types` and link an issue.

Sam W: got it. another process q: what branch name convention do we use? I saw `feature/*` and `fix/*` in some repos. Any preference for this repo?

Corey D: for runtime stuff use `eng/runtime/<short-desc>` or `fix/runtime/...` for bugfixes. keep under 50 chars, kebab-case.

Tina L: and include the ticket ID if there's one, e.g., `ENG-1234-eng/runtime-enable-caching` — makes release notes easier.

Sam W: thanks. last one: should I squash commits when merging? our repo has both squash and merge commits sometimes.

Dev CI Bot: CI pipeline started for branch eng/runtime-enable-caching (1912345678.000100).

Marta R: we use squash-and-merge for single-feature PRs to keep history tidy. if it's a big rollout with multiple logical commits, keep them and ask for a squash policy comment in the PR.

Sam W: perfect — I'll update the types and run `pnpm -w eslint --fix`. do reviewers prefer a checklist in the PR body?

Corey D: short checklist is great: what you changed, how to test locally, perf/regression notes, related tickets, and any rollout flags. examples in .github/pull_request_template.md.

Sam W: sweet. pinging @Tina L for reviewer — can you take a look after I push?

Tina L: sure — ping me when CI is green. also add `Reviewer: @tina` in the body so the bot assigns.

Sam W: will do, thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

Dev CI Bot: eslint job failed: src/runtime/kv.ts:12:8 - 'any' usage detected. See CI details: https://ci.redwood.example/1912345678/jobs/7

Sam W: okay pushing a fix now.

Corey D: if you hit flakey tests locally, try `pnpm test -- -i` to run in isolation.

Marta R: tiny FYI — for runtime changes that touch serving path, add a short note under "BREAKING CHANGES" only if behavior changes. otherwise put it under "Notes" in PR.

Sam W: noted, thanks again — will post the PR link when ready.
